cfe_lead: How JGates runs the checks in this repository. These are project rules: they apply to everyone and live in jgates.yml. Adjust what you need and save everything at once, seeing first what changes in the file.
cfe_governed_reason: Governed mode: execution is fixed by the policy {policy} and does not change here.
cfe_group_ci_lead: They apply to local validations and to jgates ci.
cfe_f_dataMaxAgeDays: Maximum age of the vulnerability data
cfe_f_trustSelfReported: Accept what the project reports about itself
cfe_h_concurrency: How many checks run at the same time.
cfe_h_network: Explicit: the plan shows which checks use the network. Allowed: they may run with network. Denied: the plan is blocked if any of them needs network.
cfe_h_failFast: When a check fails, the rest is recorded as not run.
cfe_h_timeoutSeconds: Limit of each check before it is interrupted.
cfe_h_dataMaxAgeDays: Data older than this makes the checks that read it incomplete (stale data warning). Unset, it is 7 days.
cfe_h_extensionImage: Forbid refuses any extension image. Pin requires them to be named by their sha256 digest and the tools image to be the one pinned by this JGates. Unset, extensions are not looked at.
cfe_h_trustSelfReported: Off: a check whose result the project itself controls (its tests, its build) can fail the validation but never approves it alone.
cfe_h_budgets.totalSeconds: Time limit of a whole validation.
cfe_h_budgets.memoryMegabytes: Memory limit of each tool process.
cfe_h_budgets.processes: Limit of tool processes at the same time.
cfe_h_budgets.logMegabytes: Limit of the space the logs of a validation may take.
cfe_number_invalid: Use a whole number from 1 up.
cfe_not_applied: Declared, not applied by the engine yet
cfe_review: {count, plural, =0 {Review and save} one {Review and save 1 change} other {Review and save # changes}}
cfe_review_lead: This is what changes in {file}. Nothing else in the file is touched.
cfe_conflict: jgates.yml changed since the screen was read. Reload to see the current version before saving again.
cfe_saved: {count, plural, one {1 change saved} other {# changes saved}} to jgates.yml.
cfe_retention_note: Retention of stored validations belongs to each person's data folder, not to the repository.
